criteria.GDN-025-AC01: Permission-filtered SQL feeds records, counts, facets, snippets and allowlisted secondary projections. Denied and absent byte routes use the same response.
criteria.GDN-025-AC02: Thirty-second signed application-proxy URLs bind verified subject, workspace, purpose, exact record/object version, operation and optional range/selector.
criteria.GDN-025-AC03: Archive acquisition is followed by fresh identity, RLS, version and capability checks before constructing a response.
